name: Ryntail
description: Ryntail was the personal yacht of Tan Dicium, a princeling from the celestial body Sifuchi. It partially shared its name with the Ryn, a sentient species with tails. Sometime between 0 BBY and around two months after the Battle of Yavin, Dicium visited the Inner Rim trade world Tirahnn along with his four Yuzzem bodyguards.
